# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository-specific guidance for GitHub Copilot:

- Project: xml-xsd2 — tools for working with XML and XSD (Node.js)
- Preferred language: JavaScript/Node. Follow existing code patterns.
- When making changes: keep commits small, add/update tests, run npm test and lint.
- Write clear code and comments; update specification/ when behavior changes.
- Do not add secrets or credentials. If unsure, open an issue instead of guessing.

Thank you for helping maintain code quality.
